## [1.7.0](https://github.com/RikoDEV/morphed-pl/compare/v1.6.1...v1.7.0) (2026-11-10)

### ✨ New Features

* add Lidl Plus patches ([44bf376](https://github.com/RikoDEV/morphed-pl/commit/44bf376e14bf62d7f3a295ab63a6b11fe3dd9f67))

patches.name: Auto claim coupons
patches.description: Activates every coupon that needs no article choice as soon as the coupon list loads. Each activation is the app's own "Activate" action, and refusals stay silent.

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Marketing Cloud analytics, the app's own event tracker (including the one used by the React Native screens) and the digital leaflet activity reports.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps key
patches.description: Replaces the app's Google Maps API key. The original key is locked to the developer's signing certificate, so maps stay grey in a re-signed app. Use a key you own that allows the app's package name and the SHA-1 of the key the patched app is signed with.

options.description: A Maps SDK for Android key, starting with AIza.

patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Makes Lidl Plus follow the system dark theme. Android's Force Dark darkens the window, native and React Native screens, and the Compose screens are recoloured through their paints. The loyalty card and code screens stay light so their QR codes keep scanning, and the launch screen turns dark.

patches.name: Hide home shortcuts
patches.description: Removes the round shortcut bubbles at the top of the home screen (WorldOfNeeds), the product catalog categories (productCatalog) and the small blue business model chips under the store header (businessModels).

patches.name: Hide info cards
patches.description: Removes the dismissible info cards (tipcards) from the home screen, such as the verify data, notifications and location prompts.

patches.name: Hide leaflets
patches.description: Removes the leaflet (brochures and digital leaflet) carousels from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide offers and promotions
patches.description: Removes the offers and promotions carousels from the home screen. The Coupons tab is unchanged.

patches.name: Hide online shop cards
patches.description: Removes every online shop card from the home screen: the shop teaser, search, campaign and Deal of the Day variants (onlineshop1cx*).

patches.name: Hide online shop tab
patches.description: Removes the link to the online shop from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide product carousels
patches.description: Removes the featured products, recommended products and product catalog starting page modules from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide product of the day
patches.description: Removes the online shop Deal of the Day card from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide promo banners and messages
patches.description: Removes Lidl's promo banners, video banners and the home message from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide recipes and inspirations
patches.description: Removes the recipes carousel and the product showcase (inspiration) carousels from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide sponsored ads
patches.description: Removes the sponsored brand deal slots (brandDeals_slot_a and brandDeals_slot_b) from the home screen. Their ad requests and view tracking are never made.

patches.name: Hide store header
patches.description: Removes the usual store header (store name, opening hours and store picker) from the home screen.

patches.name: Block eduVULCAN telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, plus the built-in Mnemos usage tracker. Push notifications and Firebase Remote Config keep working.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Reports an active Premium capability on every student account and removes the premium lock overlays. Billing and the store stay available.

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Blocks app analytics, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, Microsoft Clarity session recording, Adjust, Facebook app events and Synerise event tracking.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps key
patches.description: Replaces the app's Google Maps API key. The original key is locked to the developer's signing certificate, so maps stay grey in a re-signed app. Use a key you own that allows the app's package name and the SHA-1 of the key the patched app is signed with.

options.description: A Maps SDK for Android key, starting with AIza.

patches.name: Hide Von Halsky
patches.description: Removes Von Halsky shopping: the Kupuj tab, the home search box, and the banners and promotions in parcel lists, details, the cart and the More menu.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Removes the promotional banner carousel from the home screen.

patches.name: Block Yanosik telemetry
patches.description: Blocks analytics, crash reporting, usage statistics, the notiOne SDK and Wi-Fi/cell tower data collection. Location reporting for POI alerts and traffic keeps working.

patches.name: Bypass Android Auto certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses the Car App Library host certificate validation so Yanosik works on Android Auto.

patches.name: Home screen dark mode
patches.description: Makes the home screen follow the system light or dark theme.

patches.name: Remove Yanosik ads
patches.description: Removes banner ads, splash/start adverts, voice adverts, advert-based navigation POIs and selects the ad-free map style.

patches.name: Remove Yanosik radio
patches.description: Removes the built-in Radio Yanosik from the main screen and the map button.

patches.name: Unlock Yanosik PRO
patches.description: Reports an active premium entitlement and unlocks the PRO-only settings (view after launch, floating icon).

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, Quantum Metric session replay, AppsFlyer, Synerise event tracking and sponsored offer reporting.

patches.name: Hide notification prompt
patches.description: Stops the popup asking to turn on notifications.

patches.name: Hide offer carousels
patches.description: Removes the offer carousels from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide stories
patches.description: Removes the Instagram-style stories row at the top of the home screen.

patches.name: Block telemetry
patches.description: Blocks the Żabka CDP event pipeline (device, root, network and carrier data attached to every event), Sentry, AppsFlyer, Synerise event tracking, Firebase Analytics, Facebook app events and Google datatransport uploads.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps key
patches.description: Replaces the app's Google Maps API key. The original key is locked to the developer's signing certificate, so maps stay grey in a re-signed app. Use a key you own that allows the app's package name and the SHA-1 of the key the patched app is signed with.

options.description: A Maps SDK for Android key, starting with AIza.

patches.name: Spoof signing certificate
patches.description: Reports Żabka's original signing certificate to Firebase, so login works after the app is re-signed by patching.
